scope: Audit candidate administrative region references for a future overlay of the 128 national hydrological catchments; no geometry overlay or species review.

currentReference.finding: The current PSA PSGC regions page lists 18 regions, including Negros Island Region and BARMM. The public page provides official codes and names, but not region polygon geometry.
currentReference.latestPageUpdateObserved: The page lists a Third Quarter 2026 PSGC update release; the displayed region list still contains 18 regions.

dpwhPolygonCandidate.provider: Department of Public Works and Highways, Geospatial Information Authority / Statistics Division Planning Service
dpwhPolygonCandidate.sourceMetadata: The service says the source is NAMRIA and PSGC, digitally rectified by DPWH, with a June 2020 source/reference note and additional service update notes through May 2025.
dpwhPolygonCandidate.license: not stated in the REST metadata

hdxHistoricCandidate.decision: Do not use to allocate current 18-region coverage; the later repository modification date does not change the source geography vintage.

geoBoundariesCrosscheck.sourceLicense: The API record reports the underlying source license as CC BY 3.0 IGO; geoBoundaries documentation says gbOpen releases are CC BY 4.0 compliant. Resolve the two license layers before use.
geoBoundariesCrosscheck.decision: Does not provide a current 18-region geometry; no boundary file was downloaded.

limitations: PSA PSGC provides current administrative names/codes but no polygons in the reviewed page.
The DPWH ArcGIS candidate has 18 labels and a NAMRIA/PSGC source description, but no explicit reuse, redistribution, or attribution license was found.
HDX COD-AB and geoBoundaries currently expose 17-unit region layers with 2018/2020 source geography, so they cannot represent the current 18-region configuration without a revised source.
No hydrological polygons were spatially joined to regions in this review; basin-level spatial coverage remains unassigned.
next: Obtain written reuse and redistribution terms for the DPWH/NAMRIA regional boundary layer or locate a licensed polygon set matching the current PSA 18-region list.
Cross-check all polygon labels and boundary vintage against current PSGC codes before spatial overlay.
Then intersect the licensed region layer with the 128-catchment dataset and report multi-region basins without forcing each basin into one region.
Keep the region overlay as spatial scope planning only; species presence still requires independent site-linked biological sources.

accessReview.notes: No login, paid order, geometry download, email, or contact form was used.
